summary: Established a costed vertex-block boundary oracle with nontermination-as-failure, tick monotonicity and first-hit comparison. Exact q=2 and held-out q=3 tests pass. The full aspect-independent all-target RSP algorithm remains unresolved; research pass 1/3 is preserved.
next_test: Prove and exactly test offline composition on monotone rational clock-event sequences: depth-error propagation, tick-compatible time envelopes, nested whole-vertex activation, and aggregate active-vertex/incident-edge work without global scans.
